scripts.setup: npm --prefix apps/web ci && npm --prefix apps/api ci --ignore-scripts && git config --local core.hooksPath .githooks
scripts.lint: npm --prefix apps/web run lint && apps/web/node_modules/.bin/oxlint apps/api/src
scripts.test: node --experimental-strip-types --test scripts/*.test.mjs apps/web/lib/launch-model.test.ts apps/web/lib/launch-cost.test.ts apps/web/lib/user-error.test.ts apps/web/lib/preview-web3.test.ts apps/web/lib/fees-model.test.ts apps/web/lib/fee-service.test.ts apps/web/lib/claim-wallet.test.ts apps/web/lib/claim-queue.test.ts apps/web/lib/read-service.test.ts apps/web/lib/read-proxy.test.ts apps/api/src/*.test.mjs
